name: Guy Millet
abstract_title: Array-Enhanced Stochastic Resonance as a Physical Basis for Biophotonic Communication – Validation by Harmonic Coincidence Spectrometry of ATP Synthase
abstract: We propose a novel, physically-grounded framework for a high-speed biological communication system based on weakly coupled sources of biophotonic agents, with profound implications for understanding network-level phenomena like consciousness and for bridging between the quantum and classic domains. The model posits two key, testable components: a coherent signal source and a noise-robust detection mechanism.
